_about: Public-domain W. H. Griffith Thomas (William Henry Griffith Thomas, 1861-1924, Anglican evangelical, Wycliffe Hall and Wycliffe College, Toronto) for the Word Hoard, held to printings dated before 1930: The Prayers of St. Paul (Project Gutenberg, 1914), and from Internet Archive scans The Apostle Peter (1904), his devotional commentaries on Genesis (3 vols., 1908-09) and Romans (2 vols., 1911-12), The Holy Spirit of God (1913), Methods of Bible Study, The Work of the Ministry, Christianity is Christ (1916), The Catholic Faith (1920), Christ Pre-eminent (1923), And God Spake These Words (1926) and others. The Principles of Theology (1930) is outside the cutoff. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 19 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
